report_path.description: Path to report in common bucket (e.g., 'mitre/attack-stix.json' or 'capec/capec-stix.xml')

max_word_count.description: Maximum words in the generated summary (default: 2000)

ignore_caps.description: Report key_findings and relevant_techniques in full, with no upper bound. Off by default, where the lists are bounded at 50 and 200 and anything cut is counted and named in analysis_notes. Set this when the complete lists matter more than a bounded result: being told seven findings were left out does not say which seven. The lists are extracted from a summary the model already produced, so this costs no extra model call.
